decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the core map.apps platform at low maintenance cost, but its absence from the website in 2020–2021 suggests weak visibility and possible absorption into the base product, so it stays while it is checked against aspirations.
As the flagship platform defining the firm's strategic direction, it is carried with available slack despite reduced website visibility, because dropping it would undermine the core business.

Mobile field data capture meets core customer needs in public-sector and utility projects, so the missing website presence does not yet show a shortfall large enough to trigger problemistic search and withdrawal.

The search extension is a small add-on like the already withdrawn hierarchical search plugin and has vanished from the website, so its resources are better redirected to the platform and new development.
